D: An amateur stuntman tries to jump fifteen buses to raise money for his stepdad's heart operation.
P: Serve the snacks when Rod lines up the big jump.
S: Warm refried beans topped with melted cheese, salsa and sour cream, served with corn chips. Cool beans.
Rod's stunt crew on the ramp
Grilled hot dogs with mustard and onion, eaten between stunts at the quarry. Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 hot dog buns with mustard, tomato sauce and diced onion.
M: Classic beef burgers with cheese and pickles, for a summer pool party. Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties and grill 4 minutes a side with cheese.
W: Chewy choc chip cookies lined up in a long row, fifteen of them, ready for the jump.
K: Rod's dad was a stuntman, or so he thinks
Iced tea with honey and lemon in a tumbler, looking tough but going down easy.

s.how: Spread 400g refried beans in a dish, top with 150g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Top with salsa and 150g sour cream and serve with 300g corn chips.

s.note: Rod's stunt crew on the ramp
s.how: Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 hot dog buns with mustard, tomato sauce and diced onion. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties and grill 4 minutes a side with cheese. Build in 4 buns with pickles, onion and sauce. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, then 200g plain flour, 1 tsp bicarb soda and 150g chocolate chips. Bake 15 spoonfuls at 180C for 11 minutes.

d.note: Rod's dad was a stuntman, or so he thinks
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 1L hot water for 4 minutes, stir in 4 tbsp honey and cool. Serve over ice with lemon. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
